name: locbridge
subtitle: Builds of locbridge, straight from GitHub Actions.

apps.name: locbridge
apps.subtitle: Teleport your iPhone's location, on the phone itself.
apps.localizedDescription: Sets your iPhone's location from the phone itself, through Apple's developer location service. Needs LocalDevVPN. Built on Locus (MIT).

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: locbridge uses the local network to advertise as a pairable host (iOS 27 pairing) and to reach the developer tunnel (LocalDevVPN) for GPS override.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: locbridge keeps a light location session alive so simulated GPS can stay active in the background.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: locbridge uses your real location so you can aim the map and return home after teleporting.
